title: Man with guns arrested near White House, told Secret Service he planned to kill Trump, DHS says - CBS News
description: Secret Service officers found three weapons in the vehicle of the suspect, who allegedly told officers he had heard voices in his head telling him to come to Washington and assassinate the president.

title: Brandon Aiyuk meets with 49ers, says he's healthy, 'looking to get reinstated' - ESPN
description: Brandon Aiyuk met with the Niners on Friday to begin hammering out a path toward a divorce that has been more than two years in the making.

title: New Zealanders head to polls on final day of voting - Al Jazeera
description: More than half of New Zealand’s voters cast early ballots in the tightly contested race.

title: Multiple top officials exit DOJ after Dems’ midterm wave - Politico
description: The moves leave the department without some of its most seasoned hands just as congressional Democrats gear up for oversight.

title: Poised for breakout moment in Latin America, Pope Leo also faces test of health - The Washington Post
description: Just weeks after cancer surgery, Pope Leo XIV, who has arrived in Montevideo, Uruguay, will navigate the region’s tide of secularism, deep polarization — and high altitudes.
